name: 梦幻CosmicLullaby
lyrics:
[主歌1]

The 星辰 are sleeping in the silent deep
Their ancient 光芒 now drifting into 梦境
Beneath the 天空 of velvet, dark and wide
The 宇宙 holds its breath tonight

[副歌]

We float on 星光, lost in timeless sea
The 黎明 is waiting somewhere far and free
In sleeping beauty, 寂静 sings to me
A lullaby the cosmos hums

[主歌2]

The mist before the 黎明 keeps all secrets
The world holds still beneath the dreaming 天空
A thousand 星群 低语 轻柔
Their 光芒 a bridge 之间 the now and then

[副歌]

We float on 星光, lost in timeless sea
The 黎明 is waiting somewhere far and free
In sleeping beauty, 寂静 sings to me
A lullaby the cosmos hums

name: 梦幻之间Nights
lyrics:
[主歌1]

之间 the 星辰 and the 消逝 夜
A 寂静 stretches, 轻柔 as 光芒
The world holds still, the air grows thin
Somewhere 之间 where I've always been

[副歌]

And we are falling 穿过 the quiet dark
A single breath, a dying spark
The mist rises, the dreamers 沉睡
Secrets buried too deep

[主歌2]

The fog remembers what the wind forgot
A single note, a single thought
时间 folds in on itself again
Here at the 边缘 of when

[副歌]

And we are falling 穿过 the quiet dark
A single breath, a dying spark

name: 电影感Before黎明
lyrics:
[主歌1]

In the hush before the morning 光芒,
Where shadows linger in the 夜,
A 低语 stirs the distant 天空,
The world holds still, no reason why.

[副歌]

Before the 黎明, the 寂静 breaks,
A promise that the morning makes,
穿过 every darkness, comes the spark,
A flicker glowing in the dark.

[主歌2]

The 星辰 fade slow, the 天空 turns gold,
A story waiting to be told,
Each frozen breath begins to thaw,
A path unshaped by what we saw.

[副歌]

Before the 黎明, the 寂静 breaks,
A promise that the morning makes,
穿过 every darkness, comes the spark,
A flicker glowing in the dark.

[桥段]

The first 光芒 rises, 轻柔 and shy,
It catches fire across the 天空,
And every soul that's dared to dream,
Will see it burn 穿过 every seam.

[Final Chorus]
Before the 黎明, the 寂静 breaks,
The world awakens, morning's awake,
No more the 夜 defines the way,
We rise with 光芒 to start the day.
